description: This file defines the EmployeeListener class within the OrangeHRM project, implementing lifecycle event hooks for Employee entities to handle encryption and decryption of the SSN number during pre-update, post-update, and post-load events.

classes.name: EmployeeListener
classes.description: Listener class that hooks into lifecycle events of Employee entities to manage encryption and decryption of SSN numbers.

methods.name: preUpdate
methods.description: Encrypts the SSN number of the employee before the update if the field has changed and encryption is enabled.

methods.name: postUpdate
methods.description: Decrypts the SSN number of the employee after the update if encryption is enabled.

methods.name: postLoad
methods.description: Decrypts the SSN number of the employee after the entity is loaded if encryption is enabled.
